messages.raw: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
messages.text: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
messages.zh: 若你只为拥有一切而活,那你拥有多少都永远不够。

messages.context: Jacobus 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
messages.text: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
messages.zh: 空空的口袋从未阻挡过任何人,只有空洞的头脑和心灵才会。

messages.text: The real measure of your wealth is how much you'd be worth if you lost all your coins.
messages.zh: 衡量财富的真正标准,是失去所有硬币后你还值多少。

messages.context: 同页相邻对白的后续台词
messages.raw: §fWealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
messages.text: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
messages.zh: 富有不在于拥有多少,而在于想要的够少。

messages.context: 同页相邻对白的后续台词
messages.raw: §fCoins isn't everything, but everything needs coins.
messages.text: Coins isn't everything, but everything needs coins.
messages.zh: 硬币不是万能的,但没硬币却万万不能。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 13 September 2026, at 05:14.

messages.context: 同页相邻对白的后续台词
messages.raw: §fIt's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.
messages.text: It's not the Steve who has too little, but the Steve who craves more, who is poor.
messages.zh: 穷的不是拥有太少的 Steve,而是总想要更多的 Steve。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 13 September 2026, at 05:14.

messages.context: 同页相邻对白的后续台词
messages.raw: §fYou must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.
messages.text: You must gain control over your coins or the lack of it will forever control you.
messages.zh: 你得管好自己的硬币,不然缺钱这件事就会永远管着你。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 13 September 2026, at 05:14.

messages.context: 同页相邻对白的后续台词
messages.raw: §fCoins don't buy happiness, but it helps.
messages.text: Coins don't buy happiness, but it helps.
messages.zh: 硬币买不来快乐,不过确实能帮上忙。

messages.context: Trying to expand the Accessory Bag when it is already maxed
messages.raw: §cYou have reached the maximum amount of Jacobus upgrades! That was NOT a smart business decision.
messages.text: You have reached the maximum amount of Jacobus upgrades! That was NOT a smart business decision.
messages.zh: 你的 Jacobus 升级次数已达上限! 这可不是什么明智的生意。

captured_messages.text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
captured_messages.raw: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
